name: military_sites
purpose_es: Aeropuertos, aeródromos y bases militares ×2; puertos, radio/radar, centrales y bases en ruinas ×1.5 (startSV y maxSV). Además, más grupos de defensa (resistencia y ocupación) después de los topes de la misión, sin pasar de 8 grupos. Funciona en cualquier mapa: nombre del pueblo + cercanía (750 m) a los aeropuertos definidos en la configuración del terreno.
risks:
- Line endings: all three target files use CRLF. The tool must convert \n in the texts to the file's newline, as patch_gear_extra does. insert_before texts end with a newline; insert_after texts start with one and go right after the anchor, before its CRLF. Every anchor is a whole line, verified count=1 in the CW Malden copy and the vanilla copy. On other CW maps the tool must abort if count != 1.
- Performance: Airport, Military Base and Moray go from 4 to 7 groups of 6 slots, each with up to 2 vehicles; that is about 42 slots instead of 24, plus crews, while active. To soften it, set VIOC_SITES_MULT_STRONG = 1.5 (gives 5 groups).
- Gameplay: capturing these sites from the resistance takes about twice as long (SV 60 instead of 30). Their supply income is up to x2 (x1.5). Money ramps to full value twice as slowly. Value and bounty are unchanged.
- Small Military Base jumps to the top unit tier (tracked units and air in the pool, 2 vehicles per group).
- Keyword matching uses whole words. On other maps, a town literally named 'Port ...' gets x1.5, and any name with 'base' or 'military' gets x2 ('ruined'/'abandoned'/'destroyed' cap it at x1.5).
- No mod dependency; missing config keys return [] or nil-safe defaults.
- Persistence is unaffected: SV is not saved, and the town count stays the same.
- The client display stays consistent because every machine computes the same multiplier.
test_in_game_es:
1) Lanza la misión parcheada (MP alojado). En el mapa, junto a los pueblos visibles, debe verse: 'Airport SV:60/240', 'Military Base SV:60/240', 'Moray SV:60/240', 'Small Military Base SV:60/120', 'Le Port Harbor SV:45/180' y 'Radio Station', 'Le Port Power Plant' y 'Ruined Base' con 45/90. Saint Louis y el resto siguen en 30/60 o 30/120.
2) Acércate al aeropuerto con un escuadrón. El indicador de captura muestra 'Airport: 60/240 (Enemys N)' y deben aparecer más grupos enemigos que antes, unos 7 en vez de 4.
3) Carga una partida guardada: los mismos números deben aparecer ya, sin empezar de nuevo.
4) Opcional: en eon.txt o en el log debe salir '[VIOC military_sites] Airport: x2 -> startSV 60, maxSV 240'.
